# Vectixore LTD

> Advanced software engineering entity specializing in on-device AI privacy architectures, local NER redaction, and secure verification systems.

## Key Information
- [Corporate](https://vectixore.com/) - Overview of Vectixore operations, zero-knowledge architecture, and compliance standards.
- [Solutions](https://vectixore.com/solutions.html) - Enterprise AI solutions: Doxudel Desktop (on-device PII anonymization), DoubtProof™ (forensic verification), Convexight (discipline OS), and SalienTag.

- [Privacy Policy](https://vectixore.com/privacy.html) - Data protection statement, zero-cloud processing model, and UK GDPR/KVKK compliance.
- [Terms of Service](https://vectixore.com/terms.html) - Master Service Agreement, desktop software licensing, and operational terms.
- [Data Deletion Request](https://vectixore.com/data-deletion.html) - Data erasure and governance request form.
